bp-best.label: Expected runs conceded under the optimal plan
bp-best.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
bp-best.filters: Five busiest bowlers, four overs each
bp-best.query: SELECT pl.name, CASE WHEN d.over_num <= 5 THEN 0 WHEN d.over_num <= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ph, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 GROUP BY pl.name, ph
